record.intent: Evaluate ordinary option coverage, record exact physical parity questions and select useful reporting or bounded offline follow-up.
requirements: Separate token acceptance, queried state, guest persistence, capability policy and physical feature operation. Preserve any negative outcome without broadening the tested claims.
Choose the next highest-value offline branch or research/reporting task; do not repeat already-established startup, ADC or consumer results without a concrete blocker.
Preserve the exact smallest physical question under a renewed-authorization boundary. No physical scope contact during overnight work.
Admit any successor through inspected taskctl plan and expected revision, then commit and push before execution. Leave a concise morning report and clean pushed repository.
acceptance: The coverage assessment and next bounded action are committed and pushed.
